items.headline: Inception released Mercury 3, a diffusion language model with a 1-million-token context that it says generates 1,068 tokens per second on Nvidia GPUs
items.summary: The company says the model has about 40 times the parameters of Mercury 1, matches or beats GPT-6 Luna and Claude Haiku 5.5 on its benchmark table while running four to eight times faster, and is available through its API, OpenRouter, Baseten and Vercel at $0.20 per million input tokens and $0.70 output, half price at launch. All numbers are Inception's own; no independent evaluation has been published, and the model trails Haiku 5.5 on coding rows.
items.why: Diffusion decoding at four-figure tokens per second is now a production option for the latency-bound steps in an agent (classification, routing, voice), so it is worth a benchmark on your own traffic before taking the quality claims on trust.

items.headline: MiniMax released M3.1 Flash at $0.15 per million input tokens and $0.60 output, scoring 73.7% on DeepSWE v1.1 with weights promised later
items.summary: The company reports 61.7 on OSWorld V2, 82% on CyberGym and median output speeds above 170 tokens per second, and says agentic tasks cost about 70% less than on its predecessor. The weights are not yet public and no license has been named.
items.why: A sub-dollar model within a few points of DeepSeek's V4.1-Flash on agentic coding benchmarks is another candidate for the cheap-subagent tier, with the usual caveat that the scores are the vendor's.

items.headline: GitHub said it may temporarily require authentication for HTTPS clones and fetches of public repositories during periods of unusual traffic
items.summary: The protection applies to unauthenticated Git over HTTPS on all plans and is meant to protect github.com's availability; affected operations fail with a message saying authentication is required. Authenticated HTTPS, SSH, pushes and the web and API are unaffected, and GitHub says this is not a general authentication requirement for public repositories.
items.why: Any CI job, Dockerfile or script that clones a public repository anonymously can now fail intermittently, so switch it to GITHUB_TOKEN in Actions or a GitHub App token elsewhere, and treat unauthenticated clones as best-effort.
